playbooks.name: Educational / code
playbooks.description: Clear technical explanation with restrained motion and legible code or diagrams.

visualPrinciples: Use hierarchy and whitespace before decoration.
Keep code, labels, and narration focused on the same idea.
typography: Use a neutral sans-serif for explanation and a distinct monospace face for code.
Keep body text readable at delivery size and captions to two lines.
composition: Show the result or problem before implementation detail.
Keep important code and diagrams inside the selected profile title-safe area.
motion: Use motion to reveal causality or state changes.
Avoid movement that competes with code reading.
audio: Favor intelligibility and deliberate pacing over urgency.
Duck music whenever narration carries technical detail.
reviewCriteria: Technical text remains readable at delivery size.
Visual emphasis matches the narrated concept.
Pacing leaves enough time to inspect evidence.
antiPatterns: Fast pans across code that viewers must read.

playbooks.name: Talking head
playbooks.description: Footage-led speaker presentation supported by captions and sparse explanatory layers.

visualPrinciples: Preserve eye contact and natural expression.
Use support graphics only when they clarify the speaker's point.
typography: Use a robust sans-serif for captions and lower thirds.
Keep lower thirds distinct from captions and remove them after identification.
composition: Reserve stable negative space for captions or callouts.
Keep faces clear of crop boundaries and UI risk areas.
motion: Prefer motivated punch-ins, cutaways, and restrained transitions.
Do not manufacture constant movement when the performance carries the scene.
audio: Speech is the primary mix reference.
Remove distracting noise without making the voice sound processed.
reviewCriteria: The speaker remains the visual and auditory focus.
Captions, lower thirds, and callouts do not compete for the same area.
Cuts preserve sentence meaning and natural cadence.
antiPatterns: Arbitrary jump cuts that damage cadence.

playbooks.name: Short-form social
playbooks.description: Fast, mobile-first communication with an immediate hook and protected vertical safe area.

visualPrinciples: Create visual interest in the opening moment.
Make the message understandable with sound off.
typography: Use bold sans-serif captions with no more than two lines.
Keep essential text inside a centered 900 by 1400 area at 1080 by 1920 unless an exact platform profile supersedes it.
composition: Keep critical content away from bottom and side UI regions.
Treat every visual change as support for the single core idea.
motion: Use purposeful changes in framing or support visuals every few seconds.
Keep text motion brief, then hold it still long enough to read.
audio: Start speech or meaningful sound promptly when the concept calls for it.
Keep narration dominant over music and effects.
reviewCriteria: The hook is clear in the first two seconds.
The cut works without audio through captions or visuals.
Important content stays in the intended mobile-safe region.
antiPatterns: Speed used to compensate for an unclear idea.

playbooks.name: Product / demo
playbooks.description: Outcome-led product explanation with readable interface detail and evidence-backed claims.

visualPrinciples: Show the product performing the promised task.
Use annotations to direct attention, not decorate the interface.
typography: Match support typography to the product without imitating unreadable UI text.
Use short callouts with strong contrast.
composition: Frame interface details at a readable scale.
Use one primary focus per shot while preserving needed context.
motion: Let cursor, highlight, or camera motion identify the next action.
Avoid simultaneous zoom, cursor motion, and text animation.
audio: Time narration to completed product actions.
Use effects sparingly to confirm meaningful state changes.
reviewCriteria: The demonstrated workflow can be followed without guessing.
UI labels and evidence are readable at delivery size.
Narration does not get ahead of visible action.

playbooks.name: Minimal editorial
playbooks.description: Calm, high-trust visual language built from strong hierarchy, whitespace, and restrained motion.

visualPrinciples: Use a small palette with one restrained accent.
Let composition, evidence, and whitespace carry authority.
typography: Use no more than two font families.
Reserve decorative or serif faces for large editorial text, never captions.
composition: Alternate a small set of coherent layouts instead of repeating one card.
Give each frame one dominant idea.
motion: Favor fades, mask reveals, and restrained transforms.
Hold evidence frames long enough to inspect.
audio: Prefer a clean, warm voice and subtle music bed.
Use silence intentionally, not as an accidental tail.
reviewCriteria: Hierarchy remains clear without decorative effects.
Repeated layouts feel coherent rather than mechanical.
Motion intensity fits the calm editorial intent.
antiPatterns: Every scene using the same centered card.
